pubkey: Enter a valid base58 public key.
zeroKey: The zero key cannot be a treasury, buyback, feed or mint destination.
decimal: Enter the amount as a decimal string.
dailyCap: Enter 0 for unlimited, or a value up to 255.
pityShape: Expected integers for tier, hardAt, softStart and softStepBps, or null.
oddsSum: Odds sum to {sum} bps; the required total is 10,000.
quantity: A pack must contain between 1 and {max} caps.
rarityRange: The rarity index must be between 0 and {max}.
commonFloor: Common odds must be at least {min} bps.
topOdds: The top two tiers total {sum} bps, exceeding the {max} bps cap for SKU {sku}.
usdRange: The price must be between {min} and {max} USD.
u64: The price must be a decimal string within the unsigned 64-bit range.
cgCap: The hard price cap is {maxMicro} micro-$CG.
cgMove: One change may set ½–2× the live price ({currentMicro} micro-$CG). A larger adjustment requires multiple changes (SEC-F13).
packArray: Expected an array of pack objects containing sku and the fields to change.
sku: The pack SKU must be between 0 and 3.
marketCap: The market fee is capped at {max} bps.
collection: The collection index must be between 0 and {max}.
skrCap: The SKR discount is capped at {max} bps.
versionOverflow: params_version is {version}, at the u16 ceiling. The next set_params will fail; widen the field first.
splitShape: Expected {n} non-negative integer shares in bps: cap staking, token staking, quests, PvP, events.
splitSum: Shares total {sum} bps; the required total is 10,000.
splitDelta: The change of {delta} bps exceeds the ±{max} bps limit per update.
splitCooldown: Shares changed {hours} hours ago. Next change allowed: {nextAt}.
boolean: Use true to pause, or false to resume.
incidentNote: Pausing requires an incident note of at least 8 characters, saved to the audit log and status page.
evBand: Expected value / price is {ratio} %, outside {min}–{max} %. Standard anchor: {anchor} %.
starterEv: Starter should have positive expected value as an acquisition cost. This change makes its expected value {ratio} % of the price.
legendSupply: P(≥ Legend) is {probability} %, above 1.5× the standard anchor ({anchor} %). Legendary supply and fusion parity will drift.
lowMarketFee: A fee below the modeled {bps} bps reduces treasury and buyback flows (docs/02 §6).
destination: Changing {field}: sweep_vault and fees go to the new account from the next transaction. Confirm it is a Squads vault.
seasonShrinks: The PvP season share shrinks. The current season pool estimate drops from the next DayClosed event.
pauseExits: A pause blocks only new purchases, listings, stakes and battles. Unstake, cancel, refund and withdraw remain available.
resumeMultisig: Only an admin may resume. This instruction needs the multisig: 2/5 for arena, 3/5 for chip_core and staking.
alreadyPaused: {program} is already paused. This transaction changes nothing.
alreadyRunning: {program} is already running. This transaction changes nothing.
